settings.question: Is Purrkins a complete meal, or a complementary meal?
settings.answer: Complete meal! Our meals are thoughtfully crafted to meet AAFCO guidelines for your little explorer's specific daily nutritional needs, like our Mumma & Kitten for those precious early days or Baby Kitty for their growing milestones. These are complete, purposeful daily meals designed to give your purr-baby the exact nutrition they need.

settings.question: What if my kitten refuses the first bowl?
settings.answer: Cats can be very finicky with food, especially the healthier options. So we have got you covered; with every meal, we send free freeze-dried food toppers to create an irresistible aroma that your kittens can’t refuse. If you are still facing difficulties, we are just a WhatsApp message away. Always happy to help!

settings.question: How do I switch from their current food?
settings.answer:
Slow and steady is the secret to a happy tummy! Start small and only introduce 25% of Purrkins' food along with 75% of old food on day 1, and slowly transition over 1 week. Over the course of about a week, simply mix a little more Purrkins into their current meals each day. This helps their digestion adjust smoothly so they can confidently thrive on their new daily routine.

If you ever need a helping hand along the way, we're just a message away. You can easily reach us through WhatsApp.

settings.question: How does the monthly box work?
settings.answer:
We designed our monthly box to support your kitten’s whole day, from their hydrating breakfast right through to their evening play! Instead of just repeating standard food orders, you receive a complete daily routine: nourishing meals with hydrating broths and special treats designed for playtime and sweet bonding moments.

To learn more about our goodies and discover the perfect matches for your purr-baby's unique needs, explore our complete product page here.

settings.question: I have more than one cat. Now, what?
settings.answer:
First of all, we're so overjoyed to know you care so deeply about cats and kittens! Double the purrs means double the love in your home.

Take our short [Let's Build It] quiz to get a custom profile and personalized Purrkins recommendations for your cat. If you have further queries, please feel free to get in touch with us via WhatsApp.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: After placing the order, you will get an email to your registered email address and mobile number. Alternatively, you can track your order status here too.

settings.question: What to do if my cat vomits?
settings.answer: All our food is made to high standards of biosafety and export-compliant manufacturing facilities. They undergo microbiology testing and are only shipped if they are 100% safe. Vomiting might be caused by multiple underlying reasons, and we always recommend that you take them straight to your vet for further assistance. But as a responsible food company, we are always ready to go the extra mile and retest any batch or packet that you may feel has issues and share the reports. Talk to the founder directly in case of any quality-related issues through email at hari@petsofparadise.com .
